findings.text: The first paragraph tells a newcomer what Athena is, who it is for, and why it matters, all in plain words. It does its job.
findings.source: Athena is an open-source system, written in Rust, that turns a short request into a change to a code repository. … It solves the problem of AI edits that arrive unreviewed and unaccountable.

findings.text: The next step is concrete and complete: clone, a list of prerequisites, install, and a first command, with a note that it acts on the current repository and waits for Enter. The header links straight to it.
findings.source: Next steps: "Before installing, check that you have these prerequisites" … "./setup.sh" … "athena ask \"add a changelog\""

findings.text: The first section after the navigation is a raw error message. The header promises that Athena records models, verdict and cost, and this section was meant to show that, so its failure weakens the page's main claim right where a newcomer looks first.
findings.source: Check it on a real job: "The records of job 20261029-073603-7kqv could not be read here, so no models, verdict or costs are shown: no reading record for job 20261029-073603-7kqv."

findings.text: Someone arriving at Athena's home page finds that most of it is a dense study of a different tool, firstmate. The study is meant as a demonstration, but the main topic changes as soon as the header ends.
findings.source: Title and h1: "Athena explains how firstmate handles work"

findings.text: This link sits in the header and speaks to the reader as if they own the project. A newcomer is not the owner, so it adds confusion at the point where they are trying to get oriented.
findings.source: Owner view: "proposals waiting for your decision"

findings.text: The "Start here" section uses terms such as exit codes, places, capacity, teardown and pending-close records that its "Words used first" list does not define. A newcomer to firstmate would struggle to follow it without jumping to the Glossary.
findings.source: One piece of work, start to finish: "If every place of a declared capacity is held, the spawn exits 75 and the item stays queued."

findings.text: Several glossary entries say only that the term is undefined. This is honest, but it leaves a newcomer with key words they cannot pin down.
findings.source: Glossary entries for captain call, durable record, endpoint, heartbeat, wake: "The firstmate source does not define …"

findings.text: These notes describe how the page was produced and are useful to maintainers, not to a first-time reader. They add length without helping a newcomer decide what to do.
findings.source: Limits of this study, f3: "A first reading of the pinned tree missed these paths…"; About this page: "the name of the folder under studies/"
